Treatment summary
Pateint presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting right knee pain and swelling. The
mechanism and force described are consistent with the knee injury documented on initial evaluation. Over the course
of 28 visits, care was delivered at a frequency well above what is typical for this type of injury, with near-daily
sessions, and additional body regions were added to the treatment plan several wekes after the collision.
Examination shows findings that support a knee injury, including effusion and reduced range of motion on flexion,
while other orthopedic and neurovascular tests returned within normal limits. The chart notes a remote, minor strain to
the same knee that resolved completely with conservative care and no lasting limitation. Billing records reviewed for
this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.
